# Zoho Mail MCP by Velura Labs

> Open-source Model Context Protocol server that gives AI agents access to Zoho Mail: read, search, send, reply, draft, organise and delete email. 38 tools, runs locally over stdio, MIT licensed. Created by Dr Ishit Karoli, founder of Velura Labs.

## Funding

Velura Labs is actively looking for funding and welcomes contact from investors, grant programmes and partners.

- Contact: Dr Ishit Karoli, admin@veluralabs.com
- Website: https://veluralabs.com

## Docs

- [README](README.md): credentials, installation, setup for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Gemini CLI, VS Code and Codex CLI, and the full tool list
- [Usage skill](skills/zoho-mail/SKILL.md): how an agent should use the tools, including Zoho search syntax
